name: Intercom
whatYouLose: Omnichannel identity resolution and agent routing
Support automation, reporting, SLAs and enterprise security
prompt: Build a minimal website support inbox for a small SaaS. Add an embeddable chat widget, anonymous visitor sessions, realtime messages, an operator inbox, assignment, tags, canned replies, email fallback, conversation search and simple business-hours automation. Use Astro for the operator UI, vanilla JavaScript for the widget, SQLite for local development and a durable realtime-compatible database in production. Add strict origin validation, rate limits and retention controls.
notes: A simple chat widget is possible. Replacing Intercom as an operational customer-support system requires far more than its visible interface.
